title: runnerdb provider
description: A CI runner provider and its billing rules. Stored at providers/<provider-id>/provider.json.

unit.description: Unit in which usage is metered. flat: not metered; a flat fee or license (each runner then has flat_fee and price_usd_per_minute 0).

rounding.description: per_job_ceil: each job's duration is rounded up to a whole unit. per_second: no rounding beyond seconds. none: not billed. unknown: not yet verified.

base_rate_usd.description: For multiplier-based billing: USD per billing minute at multiplier 1. A runner's price_usd_per_minute must equal base_rate_usd x multiplier.

public_repo_policy.description: How jobs from public repositories are billed. Per-runner detail lives in runner.public_repo_free.
